scope: Ten empty localized architectural or landscape studies. Each requires its exact location, source incarnation and named detail; none adds a universe-wide fallback, character, collision, damage, sound recording or sprite atlas.
sourceEvidenceRule: Search results identify locations, not certified exact props, textures, official frame geometry or periods. networkVerified stays false unless a separately archived actual fetch establishes access. All repeating cycles and dimensions remain authored adaptations.

scenes.location: Dwarf Village — original 1997 empty timber doorway and cloth awning
scenes.sourceFact: Dwarf Village is a named location in the original Tomba game.
scenes.adaptedDetail: Timber entrance and cloth moving in ordinary wind; no invented canonical windmill or creature.

scenes.work: Spyro Reignited Trilogy, Spyro 2: Ripto’s Rage! (2018)
scenes.location: Summer Forest — Reignited 2018 empty stone bank and pool ripples
scenes.sourceFact: Summer Forest is the Spyro 2 hub reimagined for Reignited Trilogy, with water and stone crossings.
scenes.adaptedDetail: Empty bank outline and bounded pool ripples; no swimming character or source-frame recreation.

scenes.location: Castle Rock — original 2013 empty battlement, cordage and pennants
scenes.sourceFact: Castle Rock is the original music level in Teensies in Trouble, separate from its 8-Bit Edition.
scenes.adaptedDetail: Empty castle section with bounded wind movement of cloth and cordage. No licensed soundtrack, instrument performance or living figure is replayed.

scenes.location: Mammago Garage — original 2003 empty maintenance bay and ventilation
scenes.sourceFact: Mammago Garage services the hovercraft. It is distinct from the island outdoor Tactics sector; the Beluga hangar was rejected here because it is underneath the lighthouse.
scenes.adaptedDetail: Empty workshop frame, service lift and fan. No hovercraft body, rhino mechanic or organic healing effect.

scenes.location: Ruins of Brightholme — 2013 empty maintenance wall and ventilation bay
scenes.sourceFact: Ruins of Brightholme is an explicitly named 2013 Sanctum 2 expansion setting, not a falsely labelled base-game level.
scenes.adaptedDetail: Empty industrial wall section with a finite fan cycle. Exact wall layout, fan placement and timing are original study choices.

scenes.work: The House of the Dead, original SEGA Model 2 arcade (1996 copyright / 1997 release)
scenes.location: Curien Mansion — original Model 2 empty foyer and upper drapes
scenes.sourceFact: The original arcade game takes place at Curien Mansion and includes a foyer route.
scenes.adaptedDetail: An empty foyer opening and fabric study, with no researcher, undead, victim or chandelier attack.

scenes.location: Welcome to Rapture — original 2007 empty docking window and arrival-water refraction
scenes.sourceFact: The original opening reaches Rapture by bathysphere and establishes the Welcome Center arrival station.
scenes.adaptedDetail: Empty docking-window frame and bounded water movement, separate from the prior pressure-winch study. No bathysphere body, Splicer, blood or scripted attack.

scenes.location: Nemesis Engine Room 2 — core 2018 empty maintenance vent and access frame
scenes.sourceFact: The original ship has three numbered Engine Rooms; this selects Room 2, preserving the earlier Engine Room 1 collar study.
scenes.adaptedDetail: Original empty architectural interpretation of a board-game room tile. The fan and duct outlines are not certified official three-dimensional set geometry.

scenes.work: DAN DA DAN television anime, Season 1 (2024)
scenes.location: Ayase residence — season 1 2024 empty talisman gate and paper in ordinary wind
scenes.sourceFact: Seiko’s home and its protective talisman boundary appear in the first season. No Season 2 Kumamori Shrine or Evil Eye damage is substituted.
scenes.adaptedDetail: Empty gate and attached paper moving in a finite ordinary-wind cycle; no spell, spirit, barrier gameplay effect or character.

scenes.location: Savanna Central Station — original 2016 empty garden canopy and atrium foliage
scenes.sourceFact: Judy arrives at Savanna Central Station in the original film; the station includes a garden-inspired interior. This is distinct from the Rainforest District Tactics sector and the earlier empty escalator study.
scenes.adaptedDetail: Empty canopy ribs and distant foliage; bounded leaf motion, no passenger, train body or invented canonical clock mechanism.
